def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if any(len(set(row)) == 1 for row in grid):
        sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
        a, b = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
        # panels are stacked; compare corresponding cells
        pairs = ((a[r][c], b[r][c]) for r in range(len(a)) for c in range(w))
        vals = [x for row in a for x in row] + [x for row in b for x in row]
        bg = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(a))]
    sep = next(i for i in range(w) if len({row[i] for row in grid}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    vals = [x for row in left for x in row] + [x for row in right for x in row]
    bg = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if a == b else bg for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)] for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
